sql: SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = 100;
SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' LIMIT 100;
SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' LIMIT 100;
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS orders_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_price FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY total_price DESC;
SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_price, AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus;

SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(*) AS items_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_sum FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY total_sum DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.s_name, p.p_brand, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name, p.p_brand ORDER BY avg_cost DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT o_custkey, o_orderkey, o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o_custkey ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01';

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000);
